name: VICC Saturday Bacon Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am, year-round, from the Waterside parking lot off Deer Drive and Passerine (Waterside Place). Seven pace groups from 14-16 mph to 25+ mph.

start_location.name: Waterside Place, parking lot off Deer Drive to Passerine

visitor_notes: The club's pages say everyone is welcome and name beginner groups at 14-16 mph, but they don't say whether guests must join first, so ask the club. Group the ride by pace at the start. Lights help in the dark months.
description: The Village Idiots' Saturday road ride around Lakewood Ranch and Sarasota, called the Bacon Ride in the club calendar. Riders sort into pace groups at the start, from a 14-16 mph no-drop group up to 25+ mph. Lakewood Ranch rides here often end with breakfast.
evidence: The club's public Google Calendar has an open-ended weekly Saturday 'Bacon Ride' at 7:30 am from Waterside (event updated Feb 25, 2026) and a Sept 7, 2026 holiday ride from the same lot; the club's home page lists 'Saturday Morning Ride - 7:30 AM from Waterside Place' (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Google Calendar feed lists the weekly Bacon Ride; the club's site embeds the same calendar.

pace: E group, 12-14 mph, one rest stop at about 11 miles
name: Monday Minions (Caloosa Riders)
schedule: Every Monday, 6:30 pm, from the Publix at Colonial Crossings, Summerlin Rd. About 20 miles at 12-14 mph.
visitor_notes: No registration. Helmet, working bike and front and rear lights are required. Carry two bottles, a speedometer and a spare tube. Come early for the pre-ride safety talk. The club says this and Wednesday's Minions Plus are the best first rides with the club. Weather cancellations post on the CRBC Ride Group on Facebook.
description: Caloosa Riders' entry-level ride: about 20 miles on shared-use paths and bike lanes at 12-14 mph. The focus is riding etiquette and safety, with no paceline drafting taught or practiced. The group stops together for flats and mechanicals.
evidence: Caloosa Riders' ClubExpress calendar lists Monday Minions for Mon Oct 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026 at 6:30 PM from the Publix at Colonial Crossings; the event page says no drop, 12-14 mph, 20.4 miles (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Event pages show each week's date; the start may move earlier when daylight saving time ends.

pace: Gravel, 13-16 mph, no pace lines or close following; 21 or 28 miles (two loops)
name: Tuesday Gravel Nights (Caloosa Riders)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:15 pm, weather permitting, at Babcock Webb Wildlife Management Area (Cecil Webb). 21 to 28 miles at 13-16 mph.

start_location.name: Babcock Webb Wildlife Management Area (Cecil Webb WMA)
start_location.address: Babcock Webb Wildlife Management Area, Punta Gorda, FL 33982

visitor_notes: No registration. Bring cash for parking. Gravel or mountain bike. Not a hammer fest: the leader says the point is to look at the trees and wildlife.
description: A Tuesday-evening gravel ride on the maintained dirt roads of the Babcock Webb wildlife area, north of Punta Gorda. It is no-drop, with no pace lines. Caloosa Riders run it as a break from road traffic.
evidence: Caloosa Riders' ClubExpress calendar lists Tuesday Gravel Nights for Tue Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 at 5:15 PM at Babcock Webb WMA; the event page says no drop, 13-16 mph, 21-28 miles (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Start time may move when daylight saving time ends.

pace: All paces welcome; the group stays together
name: Wacissa Gravel/Dirt Road Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday, 9:00 am, from Wacissa River Headwaters Park. About 24 miles, 85% gravel and dirt, all paces welcome.
visitor_notes: Non-members must pre-register on the club calendar, including a signed waiver; the club recommends it for members too. Bring a gravel, cross or mountain bike with tires for unpaved roads, and insect repellent for yellow flies.
description: A Tuesday-morning gravel and dirt-road ride through Plank Road State Forest from the Wacissa River headwaters. About 85 percent of the route is unpaved. The leaders keep the group together and may add a detour down to the river.
evidence: Capital City Cyclists' ride calendar lists the Wacissa Gravel/Dirt Road Ride for Tuesdays Sept 29 and Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 at 9:00 AM; the event page says all paces welcome, 24 miles, no one dropped (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: ClubExpress calendar; each week has its own event page.

name: Tuesday After Work Ride (Killearn)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, from Killearn United Methodist Church, Shamrock St S. No drop, with regroups. Happy hour recommended, not required.
visitor_notes: Helmet and group-ride experience expected, no earbuds. Rear light and headlight highly recommended, since the route goes around a roundabout several times. Non-members should check the club's registration and waiver rules on the event page.
description: Capital City Cyclists' weekday evening road ride out of Killearn. It is a no-drop ride that regroups, and the club suggests a happy hour afterward.
evidence: Capital City Cyclists' ride calendar lists the Tuesday After Work Ride for Sept 29 and Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 at 6:00 PM from Killearn United Methodist Church; the event page says no drop ride with re-groupings (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Evening start times usually move earlier as the days shorten; check the calendar.

pace: 14-16 mph (about 30 miles, single-file paceline, limited rotation) and 16-18 mph (about 34 miles, rotating single-file paceline)
name: Love the Loop (SMBC multi-speed Saturday)
schedule: Every Saturday, 8:30 am, from Old Miakka Church, Myakka Rd. Two groups: 14-16 mph for about 30 miles and 16-18 mph for about 34 miles. Another SMBC group rides 20-23 mph from Potter Park the same morning.
visitor_notes: SMBC ride pages say non-members are welcome and ask riders to sign the waiver sheet at the start. Riders are asked to bring a non-perishable food item or a cash donation for the church food pantry.
description: Saturday multi-speed ride on the country roads east of Sarasota, from Old Miakka Church. Two pace groups share the loop through Myakka City, with a rest stop at the community park. Food for the church pantry is the entry fee.
evidence: SMBC's ride calendar lists Love the Loop Multi-speed Groups for Sat Oct 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31, 2026, 8:30-11:30 AM from Old Miakka Church; the event page gives the two groups and says non-members are welcome (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: HuntCal month view lists every ride; event pages carry the leaders and routes.

name: Legacy Trail and Casey Key (SMBC Sunday)
schedule: Every Sunday, 8:30 am, from the Ashton Road Trailhead on the Legacy Trail. Three groups: 12-14 mph for 25 miles, 13-15 mph for 26 miles, 14-16 mph for 31 miles.

start_location.name: Ashton Road Trailhead (Ashton Park), Legacy Trail

visitor_notes: SMBC's Wednesday ride page says non-members are welcome and asks for a signed waiver at the start; this event page doesn't repeat it. The 31-mile group was on hold for the summer and was due back in October.
description: A Sunday ride on the Legacy Trail south of Sarasota with the slower pace groups in SMBC's week. One group rides the trail to the old train depot and back, another loops out to Nokomis Beach and up Casey Key.
evidence: SMBC's ride calendar lists Legacy Trail and Casey Key for Sun Oct 4, 11, 18 and 25, 2026, 8:30-11:00 AM from the Ashton Road Trailhead; the event page gives the three pace groups (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: HuntCal month view lists every ride.

pace: 12-14, 14-16, 16-18 and 17-19 mph groups (a 10-12 mph group is paused until a leader steps up)
name: Lakewood Ranch Town Hall Ride (SMBC Wednesday)
schedule: Every Wednesday, 8:30 am, from Lakewood Ranch Town Hall. Several groups from 12-14 mph up to 17-19 mph, 20 to 36 miles. A 10-12 mph group returns when a leader is found.

start_location.name: Lakewood Ranch Town Hall (large lot near the lake, not in front of the administration building)
start_location.address: 8175 Lakewood Ranch Blvd, Lakewood Ranch, FL 34202

visitor_notes: The ride page says non-members are welcome, and asks you to sign the waiver sheet when you arrive. Most rides are single pacelines. Many groups go for breakfast or lunch afterward.
description: SMBC's midweek ride from Lakewood Ranch Town Hall, with up to five speed groups and posted routes for each week. A good way for a visitor to meet local riders, since the club invites non-members to come along.
evidence: SMBC's ride calendar lists the Lakewood Ranch Town Hall ride for Wed Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2026, 8:30-11:00 AM; the event page lists the groups, routes through Oct 28, and says 'Non-members are welcome' (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: HuntCal month view lists every ride; routes by week are on the event page.

pace: Monday, Wednesday, Friday 20 mph controlled; Tuesday and Thursday 17-19 mph on the first loop
name: Weekday USFSP Ride (St. Petersburg Bicycle Club)
schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 am sharp, from the USFSP campus (2nd St S and 6th Ave S, by the bronze bull). About 17 miles, with a faster second loop for another 9. Show and go.

start_location.name: USFSP campus, 2nd St S and 6th Ave S, green concrete balls in front of the bronze bull
start_location.address: 6th Ave S and 2nd St S, St. Petersburg, FL

visitor_notes: Show and go, no sign-up. Up to 50 riders on a given day. The club's Facebook group has the latest updates.
description: The St. Pete club's daily weekday road loop: 4th St S to Pinellas Point Drive, north through Lakewood, and home on 6th Street, with three optional sprint points. Some days a second, faster partial loop follows.
evidence: SPBC's rides page lists the Mon-Fri USFSP ride at 8:00 AM sharp with Monday/Wednesday/Friday and Tuesday/Thursday paces; the same page gives 2026 dates for the Saturday and Tuesday start-time changes (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Page states the schedule; club Facebook group has week-to-week changes.

pace: Green ride, 19-20 mph controlled, double paceline
name: Naples Velo Monday Recovery Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 7:00 am, from the side lot of Naples Cyclery. Four laps in Pelican Bay at a controlled 19-20 mph, about 20 miles.
visitor_notes: The club says it welcomes cyclists of all skill levels. The page doesn't say whether guests need to join; ask the club.
description: A recovery ride from Naples Velo: four laps inside Pelican Bay in a double paceline, held to 20 mph, easy out of corners and stops. Meant for the day after the hard weekend rides.
evidence: Naples Velo's North Naples rides page states the Monday 7am recovery ride from Naples Cyclery; the page is undated, but the club's home page shows 2026 sponsors and led rides seven days a week (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

pace: C ride, rolling 16-18 mph; the club's home page offers 14, 28, 63 and 100 mile options on its flagship Saturday ride
name: TCCA Saturday Cyclewerks Ride (B/C+)
schedule: Every Saturday, meet 7:15 am, roll 7:30 am, from Treasure Coast Cycle Werks. 25 to 35 miles at 16-18 mph, no drop.

start_location.name: Treasure Coast Cycle Werks
start_location.address: 8611 S US Hwy 1, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952

visitor_notes: The club welcomes all skill levels. Sign the waiver on the club's event page and introduce yourself to the ride leader; the club hopes you'll join afterward. Bring hydration, nutrition and safety gear.
description: Treasure Coast Cycling Association's flagship Saturday ride from Treasure Coast Cycle Werks in Port St. Lucie. The B/C+ listing is a no-drop C-pace ride of 25 to 35 miles. The club's page sends first-timers to sign a waiver and meet the leader.
evidence: TCCA's home page lists the B/C+ Ride - Cyclewerks for Sat Oct 3, 10, 17 and 24, 2026 at 7:30 AM from Treasure Coast Cycle Werks; the event page says every Saturday, no drop C ride, 16-18 mph, 25-35 miles (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Wild Apricot site; the home page lists the next public events.

pace: Open group 22+ mph, A group 20-22 mph, B group 18-20 mph
name: Estero Bicycle Cafe Sunday Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 7:15 am, from Estero Bicycle Cafe. About 35 miles, three speed groups on the same route: Open 22+ mph, A 20-22, B 18-20.

start_location.name: Estero Bicycle Cafe, Estero Ridge Plaza

visitor_notes: No registration. The ride leaders for each group are listed on the Caloosa Riders calendar entry.
description: A fast Sunday ride from Estero Bicycle Cafe: out over the Estero Pkwy bridge to Ben Hill Griffin, north through the airport to Treeline Ave and back. All three groups follow the same route. Caloosa Riders list it on their calendar.
evidence: Caloosa Riders' ClubExpress calendar lists the Estero Bicycle Cafe Ride for Sun Oct 4, 11, 18 and 25, 2026 at 7:15 AM; the event page gives the 35-mile route and three groups (fetched Oct 1, 2026). The shop's own page was not read.

refresh.notes: Listed on the Caloosa Riders calendar; each week has an event page.

name: Gravel GRIT Night Ride
schedule: Second Thursday of the month, meet 6:30 pm, wheels down 6:45 pm. Seminole State Forest, 15 to 20 miles, routes change monthly. Dark for much of the ride.

start_location.name: Seminole State Forest (meeting point on the shop's event link)

visitor_notes: Helmets and lights are required. E-bikes welcome. Gravel tires, water and nutrition recommended. The shop asks riders to read the assumption-of-risk waiver on its page.
description: Bicikleta's monthly night gravel ride through Seminole State Forest. Routes run 15 to 20 miles and change from month to month, and a good part of it is in the dark.
evidence: Bicikleta Bike Shop's events and rides page (fetched Oct 1, 2026; it also lists Oct 17, Oct 25 and Dec 21, 2026 events) lists the Gravel GRIT Night Ride for the 2nd Thursday of the month, meet 6:30 PM, wheels down 6:45 PM.

refresh.notes: The shop's page states the schedule; the meeting point is on its Facebook event link, which didn't load.

name: Monthly Recumbent Rollout
schedule: First Saturday of the month, 7:30 am roll-out from Bicikleta Bike Shop. 10 to 15 miles on paved trails, onto the RiverWalk.
visitor_notes: For recumbent riders. Shop page asks riders to read the assumption-of-risk waiver.
description: A monthly recumbent ride out of Bicikleta in Sanford. About 10 to 15 miles on paved trails, rolling onto the RiverWalk. The shop describes it as good company and good scenery.
evidence: Bicikleta Bike Shop's events and rides page (fetched Oct 1, 2026; it also lists Oct 17, Oct 25 and Dec 21, 2026 events) lists the Monthly Recumbent Rollout for the first Saturday of every month, 7:30 AM roll-out.

refresh.notes: Static schedule on the shop's page.
